occasions.lede: A birthday, a proposal, or no reason at all. Every day starts with one person and becomes a memory they never saw coming.
occasions.moreLabel: And so many other moments to celebrate

scenarios.title: For her 38th birthday
scenarios.tagline: She thought it was just another Saturday.
paragraphs: Two “agents” in dark suits ring the bell at dawn: “Come with us, no questions.” A hot air balloon over the Île-de-France, a table set for her alone in a château's orangery, a private spa... and that evening, all her friends are waiting.

scenarios.title: For the marriage proposal
scenarios.tagline: She followed the clues. He was waiting at the end.
paragraphs: A riddle under the coffee cup leads to a bookseller, then to a captain and his compass that doesn't point north. She follows it to Versailles, where a violin begins to play at the end of a petal-strewn path. He's there. She said yes.

scenarios.title: For his 60th birthday
scenarios.tagline: He thought everyone had forgotten his birthday.
paragraphs: A letter from his children, a pair of aviator sunglasses, and a vintage car whose destination he doesn't know. It leads him to an airfield, a vintage biplane, and childhood friends reunited after twenty years. That evening, three generations are waiting for him around one table.

occasions.scenariosFooter: Every day is written for one person only, never the same twice. Yours starts with a conversation.

moments.h2: One moment, among every step of their day
moments.lede: This is only a glimpse: every day is designed as a whole, from morning to night.
moments.cta: Want a day like this one? Tell us about yours.

montgolfiere-fete-des-meres.title: Grégoire, a hot air balloon flight for Mother's Day
montgolfiere-fete-des-meres.story: He wanted to give his mother a moment that belonged to just the two of them, away from everyday life. Among all the steps we designed for that day, this one was the high point: a hot air balloon chartered just for them, drifting above the golden countryside at sunset.

degustation-vin.title: Aymeric, a wine tasting in a secret cellar for his father's 60th birthday
degustation-vin.story: He wanted to give his father a moment that belonged to just the two of them, away from the usual family dinners. We built an entire day around that idea, and at its heart, a century-old cellar in Paris, a sommelier at their side and the finest vintages to discover together.

croisiere-seine.title: Pascal, a dinner cruise on the Seine for their tenth year together
croisiere-seine.story: He wanted to mark ten years together with a whole day that felt like them. Among the steps we strung together for them, this one stayed the most memorable: a private cruise on the Seine, roses and champagne on the table, the illuminated Eiffel Tower as their only witness.

opera-chauffeur.title: Daphné, an evening at the Opéra with a private driver to surprise her husband
opera-chauffeur.story: She wanted to give him a day where all he had to do was be carried from one moment to the next. We built it for him step by step, up to this high point: a dinner followed by an evening at the Opéra Garnier, private car and driver from departure to return.

caleche-saint-valentin.title: Olivier, a horse-drawn carriage ride through Paris for their Valentine's Day
caleche-saint-valentin.story: He wanted to give them a Valentine's Day suspended in time, far from traffic and phones. We planned it step by step, and along the way, a vintage carriage, coachman in a top hat, for a tour of Paris at a horse's pace all the way to the foot of the Eiffel Tower.

demande-mariage-coucher-soleil.title: Fernand, a bespoke day leading up to his marriage proposal
demande-mariage-coucher-soleil.story: He wanted to give his wife-to-be a day just for her, building up to the moment he'd ask the question. We planned it step by step: a horse ride, dinner on a barge along the Seine, then an hour's drive into the countryside, where he got down on one knee at sunset.

process.lede: Four steps, from the first conversation to the day itself.

steps.title: The story
steps.body: Who the day is for, the date in mind, what moves them, what they can't stand, a memory that matters: every detail helps us compose a day that truly feels like them.

steps.title: The script
steps.body: We come back to you with the day fully imagined: an hour-by-hour itinerary and a clear presentation of the pricing.

steps.title: Behind the scenes
steps.body: Before final approval, we refine every detail with you, live, until it's exactly what you pictured.

steps.title: The big day
steps.body: On the day itself, we take care of the entire experience: all you have to do is live the moment.

paragraphs: It all started one night.
We knew exactly who we wanted to bring a moment of happiness to, heads full of ideas, without yet knowing how to turn that wish into a day worthy of it.
We went looking for help.
Everywhere, the same ready-made packages, the same boxes to tick.
So we imagined it all ourselves: the itinerary, the venues, every surprise, down to inviting their loved ones to play a part in the day too.
Then the day came.
Watching their surprise, their emotion, one thing became clear: we hadn't just created an activity. A whole story to live.
That's how Yurday was born.
Today, the idea hasn't changed one bit.
You entrust us with the person, the occasion, your budget.
We imagine everything else.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: Every day is different, so every budget is too. We always build the day around the starting budget you give us, never the other way around.

items.question: How far in advance should I contact you?
items.answer: Once we're in touch, allow about 2 weeks from when we send our questionnaire for the day to be ready. We can move faster for urgent projects, tell us your timeline and we'll tell you honestly what's possible.

items.question: Where do you operate?
items.answer: We currently operate in Paris and its surrounding area (Île-de-France). Tell us where you are and we'll quickly confirm if it's possible.

items.question: What if we're a group (bachelor/bachelorette party)?
items.answer: No problem: we always separate the person being celebrated from the group living the day, so the logistics (meals, transport, activities) are costed accurately, either per head or as a flat rate, whichever makes sense.

items.question: How does payment work?
items.answer: You pay nothing until you've validated the program and the price. Payment only happens once everything works for you.

items.question: How do you keep it a surprise for the person?
items.answer: We build the whole logistics so they never suspect a thing: appointments presented as something else, loved ones briefed, timing worked out to the minute. You tell us what they already know, we handle the rest.

anniversaire.intro: Tell us about the birthday you have in mind for your loved one, and we'll imagine their perfect day, from the first surprise to the very last moment.

scenario.label: A day, told as a story
scenario.title: For the bachelor party
scenario.tagline: A real mission. No tutu, no inflatable costume.
paragraphs: On waking, an agent delivers the mission orders: an envelope sealed in wax, strict instructions, no explanation. First challenge in the Rambouillet forest, archery; the groom-to-be takes aim, his best men commentate.

At the bistro, the waiter slips a clue under the plate. Second challenge: polo, though no one has ridden a horse since summer camp. Third challenge: an investigation in a château, where the butler knows more than he lets on.
Mission accomplished: a medal, cocktails and a hidden bar. The night is theirs.

fete-des-meres.intro: Tell us what you'd like to give your mum for Mother's Day, and we'll imagine her perfect day, filled with everything she loves.
fete-des-meres.story: We know how hard it can be to find the right way to thank your mum, beyond flowers grabbed at the supermarket the night before. Tell us who she is and what she loves, and we'll build a day around her that truly feels like her.

cta.title: Ready to thank her differently?
cta.text: Tell us about your mum, and we'll get back to you with the first ideas within 24 hours.

scenario.label: A day, told as a story
scenario.title: For Mother's Day
scenario.tagline: She always thought of everyone else. This day, everyone thinks of her.
paragraphs: At brunch, a surprise: her sister, who she thought was in Lyon, crossed France to be there. In a perfumer's workshop, a scent is composed that will carry her name. The two sisters then have lunch on a privately chartered boat, just like before.
A pastry chef opens up his kitchen to her: tonight's dessert, the choux pastries, are hers to make. Then a rowing boat on the lake in the Bois de Boulogne, with nothing else to do.
At dessert, an actor reads her children's letters aloud. Years of memories fit into a few pages.

anniversaire-de-mariage.intro: Tell us your story as a couple, and we'll imagine a day that celebrates your years together, just like the first day.
anniversaire-de-mariage.story: A wedding anniversary isn't just a date to tick off. It's a chance to say what you don't say enough anymore, and to create one more memory after all these years. We build this day from your own story, never from a standard programme.

cta.title: Ready to rekindle the flame?
cta.text: Tell us your story as a couple, and we'll get back to you with the first ideas within 12h.

scenario.label: A day, told as a story
scenario.title: For their 40th wedding anniversary
scenario.tagline: They hadn't given each other anything in years.
paragraphs: A car like the one from their youth pulls up outside their home, a white ribbon on the hood. The laughter starts at the door. A rowing boat is waiting, just like their first date: he rows, she pretends not to watch him.

A picnic in the grounds of a château, champagne well chilled. In Montmartre, a painter paints their portrait, destined for the living room. At the guinguette, the band plays their song, the one from their first dance.
That evening, surrounded by their children and grandchildren, they say “I do” again.
